dimensions.assessment: Directly affects SBA headquarters employees whose duty stations or telework arrangements would change.
dimensions.evidence: change the permanent duty station of not less than 30 percent of the headquarters employees of the Administration

dimensions.assessment: Involves relocation, adjustments to local pay rates, elimination of full-time telework for affected staff, and significant office space reductions.
dimensions.evidence: reduce the amount of office space for the headquarters of the Administration by not less than 30 percent

dimensions.assessment: Requires the Administrator to determine that the changes will reduce costs to the federal government.
dimensions.evidence: if the Administrator determines that implementing the requirements under paragraphs (1) and (2) of this subsection will reduce the cost to the Federal Government

dimensions.assessment: Imposes new operational, reporting, and structural mandates specifically on the Small Business Administration.
dimensions.evidence: To require the Administrator of the Small Business Administration to relocate 30 percent of the employees assigned to headquarters

dimensions.assessment: One-time implementation requirements for relocation and office downsizing, paired with ongoing reporting rules in budget materials.

missing_information: Total number of current SBA headquarters employees
Exact dollar amounts of savings or relocation expenses
importance_detail.rationale: Requires the Small Business Administration to relocate at least 30 percent of headquarters employees outside the Washington metropolitan area and reduce headquarters office space by at least 30 percent.
